requests.reason: Is getting hungry but cannot leave their post during the shift, so asks the learner to buy something to eat from another shop.
requests.ko: 배고픈데 근무 중이라 자리를 비울 수 없어 학습자에게 다른 가게의 먹을 것을 사다 달라고 부탁한다

requests.reason: Feels worn out but cannot leave their post during the shift, so asks the learner to buy a coffee from another shop.
requests.ko: 지쳤는데 근무 중이라 자리를 비울 수 없어 학습자에게 다른 가게의 커피를 사다 달라고 부탁한다

goal.desc: The learner recommends a specific place in town and gives a reason.

requests.reason: Has had no one to talk to for a while, so asks the learner to recommend a place in town worth seeing and why.
requests.ko: 한동안 말 상대가 없어 학습자에게 마을에서 구경할 만한 곳과 이유를 묻는다

goal.desc: The learner states their whole order (item, option, and here or to go) clearly in one turn.

requests.reason: The shop just got very busy, so politely asks the learner to give their whole order in one sentence.
requests.ko: 손님이 밀려 바빠 학습자에게 주문을 한 문장으로 말해 달라고 한다

goal.desc: The learner politely picks another item after hearing one is sold out.

requests.reason: One item on the menu sold out today, so tells the learner and asks what they would like instead.
requests.ko: 메뉴 하나가 다 팔려 학습자에게 알리고 다른 것을 고르게 한다

requests.reason: The register is short of small bills and they cannot leave the counter, so asks the learner to get change for a 20-dollar bill at the bank.
requests.ko: 계산대에 잔돈이 모자라 학습자에게 은행에서 20달러를 잔돈으로 바꿔 달라고 부탁한다

requests.reason: Has a letter that must go out today but cannot leave their post, so asks the learner to send it at the post office.
requests.ko: 오늘 부쳐야 할 편지가 있는데 자리를 비울 수 없어 학습자에게 우체국에서 부쳐 달라고 부탁한다

requests.reason: Wants to brighten up the counter but cannot leave their post, so asks the learner to bring one wrapped flower from the flower shop.
requests.ko: 계산대를 밝히고 싶은데 자리를 비울 수 없어 학습자에게 꽃집에서 꽃 한 송이를 포장해 와 달라고 부탁한다
